label: PAXG launch, the first NYDFS-approved tokenized gold
PAXG extends to Solana, its first deployment beyond Ethereum
note: 2026-06-25: Paxos extends PAXG to Solana as a Token-2022 mint with Sunrise DeFi; Ethereum holders can bridge via the Paxos platform or LayerZero Stargate.

label: Paxos freezes 1,907 PAXG on Ethereum after Binance hack
note: At Ethereum block 26301400 (2026-10-29 22:30:47 UTC), Paxos froze address 0x5227f603C1eE34CE3C06eFe6477003BDfCCB2f8c on the PAXG contract, locking 1,906.67 PAXG (about $7.6M at late October 2026 gold prices) linked to the October 29 Binance hack.
